method: AI linguistic analysis of exact-member-checked cases; not independent lexicographic or contextual corpus verification

policy.membership: never remove or add on AI judgment alone
policy.recognition: query-time multiword spans may be recognized without creating lexicon members
policy.release: quality overlay only; Scene500 runtime untouched

special_cautions.这会: 区别‘这会儿/这会’时间表达与‘这+会’组合，不能一概拆分
special_cautions.通过: 可以作动词或介词，字符串可拆分不代表非词
special_cautions.肿: 可能作形容/语素；医学检索需要上下文而不是直接收为一般词项
special_cautions.北京时间: 多词专名/时间表达的查询识别不等于必须进入20K成员
special_cautions.救命: 作为独立交际功能表达值得后续语料确认，不能因没入库就删去召回
special_cautions.我要: 组合短语通常不是一个独立词项，但可用于查询意图解析

next_required: For every proposed member change attach independent attested tokenized sentences + cross-domain frequency + lexical/source provenance; then run migration and Scene500 association checks
